# Release notes

How release note bodies are written for both products. This is a convention,
not a procedure: the release steps live in the `release` skill and the
workflows.

| Product | Where the body lives                                                        | Where it is published                                    |
| ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| Desktop | `.loctx/release/<version>_<Release\|Pre-Release>.md` (local, not committed) | The GitHub Release, via `gh release edit --notes-file`   |
| Server  | `docs/server/release/<version>.md` (committed in the release PR)            | Nowhere else: the server **never** gets a GitHub Release |

An rc is the preview of a finished version (after merge and audit), cut to
make the final adjustments before stable. Its note says what the version
contains and what to verify, not what one work unit added.

## Desktop

### Titles and tags

Tags are `desktop-vX.Y.Z[-rc.A]` from the first 1.3.0 pre-release on; `v1.2.6`
and earlier keep the old unprefixed tags.

| Kind        | GitHub Release title            | File                                       |
| ----------- | ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| Stable      | `Croffle vX.Y.Z — Release Note` | `.loctx/release/X.Y.Z_Release.md`          |
| Pre-release | `Pre-Release vX.Y.Z-rc.A`       | `.loctx/release/X.Y.Z-rc.A_Pre-Release.md` |

### Changelogs section

The last section is always `## Changelogs` and is generated by GitHub:

```
gh api -X POST repos/team-croffle/croffle/releases/generate-notes \
  -f tag_name=<tag> -f previous_tag_name=<previous tag> --jq .body
```

Paste the output as is, but rename its `## What's Changed` heading to `## Changelogs`. Keep everything else GitHub generated (PR list, `**Full Changelog**` link, contributor lines). `previous_tag_name` is the previous desktop tag in semver order (for a stable release: the previous stable tag, so the list spans every rc). Server tags never count as a previous tag.

The Korean block only says `- 하단 참조` under `## Changelog`; the English block carries the generated list.

### Publishing

The release workflow leaves the release as a **draft**, and electron-updater cannot see drafts. After the run succeeds:

```
gh release edit <tag> --title "<title>" --notes-file .loctx/release/<file> --draft=false [--prerelease]
```

Then verify with `gh release view <tag> --json name,isDraft,isPrerelease,assets`.

### Stable template — `X.Y.Z_Release.md`

```
<details>
<summary>한국어 릴리즈 노트 (Korean)</summary>

# Croffle vX.Y.Z

vX.Y.Z는...

프리릴리스 **rc.A, rc.B, rc.C...**에서 검증한 내용을 포함합니다.

## Overview

### 기능명

설명

...

## Bug Fixes

- 해결한 문제
- 이슈로 등록된 해결한 문제 (#<number>)

## Known limitations (vX.Y)

- 한계점 서술

## Included pre-releases

### rc.A

- 내용...

...

## Changelog

- 하단 참조

</details>

---

# Croffle vX.Y.Z

summary for vX.Y.Z

It includes everything validated in **rc.A, rc.B, ...**

## Overview

### Feature Name

Summary for Feature

...

## Bug Fixes

- bug and fixed summary...
- fixed issues (#<number>)

## Known limitations

- ....

## Included pre-releases

### rc.A

- summary

## Changelogs

<GitHub generated, heading renamed; keep the rest of the generated text>
```

### Pre-release template — `X.Y.Z-rc.A_Pre-Release.md`

```
<details>
<summary>한국어 (Korean)</summary>

# Pre-Release vX.Y.Z-rc.A

버전 설명

## Overview

변경 요약

## Changelogs

- 하단 참조

</details>

---

# Pre-Release vX.Y.Z-rc.A

Summary of this version

## Overview

details of this version

## Changelogs

<GitHub generated, heading renamed>
```

Writing rules: Overview describes user-visible behaviour, not files. Mention PR numbers in Bug Fixes / Overview when helpful (`#84`). Include a "확인 요청 / Please verify" bullet when a change needs the user's manual check on a packaged build. Run URLs, commands, and QA logs do not belong here; they go to `.loctx/history/` and `.loctx/reports/`.

## Server

The server ships as the `ghcr.io/team-croffle/croffle-server` image only. A
GitHub Release in this repository would become `/releases/latest` and stop
every desktop client from updating, so the server's notes are a committed file
instead: `docs/server/release/<version>.md` (`0.1.0-rc.1.md`, `0.1.0.md`), with
the tag `server-vX.Y.Z[-rc.A]`.

### Template — `docs/server/release/<version>.md`

```
# croffle-server vX.Y.Z[-rc.A]

Image: `ghcr.io/team-croffle/croffle-server:X.Y.Z[-rc.A]` · tag `server-vX.Y.Z[-rc.A]` · protocol `min`–`max`

<one-paragraph summary>

## Overview

- user-visible change (operators and desktop clients)

## Upgrade notes

- migrations, config or env changes, anything an operator must do

## Compatibility

- desktop versions this server works with

## Known limitations

- ...

<details>
<summary>한국어</summary>

# croffle-server vX.Y.Z[-rc.A]

요약

## 변경 사항

- ...

## 업그레이드 안내

- ...

</details>
```
